description: This header file defines the API for marshalling and unmarshalling support for Abseil flags, including overloads for fundamental types, support for std::optional, and mechanisms for custom types via ADL. It provides functions for parsing and unparsing flag values, and manages internal overloads for various supported types.

methods.name: ParseFlag
methods.description: Template function that parses a string into a flag value of type T, delegating to internal overloads.

methods.name: UnparseFlag
methods.description: Template function that converts a flag value of type T into its string representation.
